Name: Spouse Bunnies
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=4]The bunnies can be purchased for 10 mixed seeds after reaching 10 hearts with your marriage candidate of choice(Although multiple can be purchased if you aren't feeling monogamous) .[/size]

[size=4]The shop for the bunnies can be found between the Bookseller and Jojamart/Movie Theatre[/size]

[size=4]The bunnies can be found in the furniture catalogue with a config option.[b](Not Recommended for whimsical individuals (Clark needs his seeds!!!)) [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Modded NPCs:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]All [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded [/url]Romanceable NPCs + Apples[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]All [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][/url]Romanceable NPCs[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44286]Arumi the Actress[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Sen ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark[/url])[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44610]Ivaras[/url][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]I might add more bunnies for modded Marriage candidates so feel free to leave a suggestion, and ill see if the creator of the mod is ok with it![/size]

[size=3][b]Fun fact: The bird in this mod is a Clark's Nutcracker, which is a species of corvid that likes to bury seeds to eat later, and will bury thousands of seeds(mostly pine seeds) to prepare for winter. Although most of them they will forget to eat, and those seeds will grow into trees![/b][/size]
